    @pytest.mark.xdist_group(name="group1")
    # @pytest.mark.skip(reason="Login after change password doesn't work because of captcha token")
    @allure.title("Restore user password")
    def test_restore_password(self, page: Page):
        login_page = LoginPage(page)
        dashboard_page = DashboardPage(page)
        email_subject = "Reset your password"
        new_password = "autotest_new_password_test"
        user_email = cfg.EMAIL_USER.get("username")
        user_password = cfg.EMAIL_USER.get("password")
    
        with allure.step("Test preparation"):
            email_qa = Email(cfg.EMAIL_QA.AUTH)
            login_page.goto()
    
        with allure.step("Initialize restore password"):
            login_page.click_forgot_password_link()
            assert login_page.wait_for_forgot_password_page() is True
            assert login_page.forgot_password_title in login_page.get_page_title()
            login_page.insert_email(user_email)
            login_page.click_reset_password_button()
            assert login_page.wait_for_change_password_page() is True
    
        with allure.step("Parse code from email and enter"):
            message = email_qa.get_messages_by_subject(subject=email_subject, timeout_seconds=30, timedelta_minutes=1)
            content = email_qa.get_message_content(message[0])
            code = login_page.get_restore_password_code(content)
            login_page.insert_code(code)
            login_page.click_next_button()
    
        with allure.step("Enter new password"):
            assert login_page.wait_for_set_new_password_page() is True
            login_page.insert_password(new_password)
            login_page.insert_repeat_password(new_password)
            login_page.click_reset_password_button()
    
        with allure.step("Verify success password restore"):
            assert login_page.wait_for_success_restore_password_page() is True
            login_page.click_go_to_sign_in_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Sign in with new password"):
            login_page.insert_email(user_email)
            login_page.insert_password(new_password)
            login_page.click_sing_in_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Verify login with new password"):
            dashboard_page.wait_for_dashboard_url()
            assert dashboard_page.wait_for_running_deals_widget() is True
            assert dashboard_page.page_title in dashboard_page.get_page_title()
    
        with allure.step("Return default password"):
